name: Branch
description: A branch dragged in from the treeline, still green at the cut.

name: Log
description: A short length of trunk. Two people and a bad afternoon.

name: Salvaged Timber
description: Furniture that lost an argument with a crowbar. Still has the varnish on it.

name: Sawn Plank
description: A plank cut square and stacked dry, from back when somebody was paid to do that.

name: Pallet Board
description: A board prised off a pallet, nail holes and all.

name: Rubble
description: Broken masonry off a collapsed wall. Heavy, awkward, and there is always more.

name: Cut Stone
description: A dressed block off a garden wall. Nothing gets through a course of these.

name: Plant Fibre
description: A handful of stripped stalk, retted and combed out. It wants twisting into something.

name: Burlap Sacking
description: Coarse sacking, stiff with old grain dust.

name: Twine
description: A ball of garden twine. It ties what it is asked to tie and no more.

name: Rope
description: A coil of rope, stiff from the weather and sound in the middle.

name: Nails
description: A jar of nails, most of them straight.

name: Screws
description: A drawer's worth of screws, sorted by somebody who had the time.

name: Bolts and Washers
description: Coach bolts with the washers still threaded on. Whatever they held is gone.

name: Steel Ingot
description: A cast bar of steel, grey and dense, with the mould seam still on it.

name: Aluminium Ingot
description: An ingot light enough to be suspicious about, poured from melted cans.

name: Lead Ingot
description: Soft, dull, and heavier than it has any business being.

name: Sack of Charcoal
description: A paper sack of barbecue charcoal, gone soft at the corners.

name: Lump Charcoal
description: Charcoal burned down in somebody's kiln. It marks everything it touches.

name: Raw Clay
description: Wet clay off the riverbank, wrapped in plastic so it keeps.

name: Fired Brick
description: A common brick, frost-chipped along one edge.

name: Copper Wire
description: Cable stripped back to the bright metal. Somebody went through a wall for this.

name: Steel Wire
description: A roll of fencing wire, springy and hard on the hands.

name: Barbed Wire
description: A coil of barbed wire off a field boundary. It fights the person carrying it.

name: Circuit Board
description: A board pulled out of something that used to work, traces intact.

name: Salvaged Components
description: A tin of capacitors and resistors, desoldered by somebody patient.

name: Relay
description: A sealed relay off a control panel. It still clicks when you shake it.

name: Sheet Metal
description: A panel cut off something larger, edges sharp where the shears went through.

name: Steel Pipe
description: A length of pipe with the threads still clean at one end.

name: Rebar
description: Reinforcing bar cut out of a slab, ribbed and rust-orange.
